accounts.name: vault
docs: Required only when the order is funded.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: One receipt per invoice reference: an invoice can never be paid (or counted) twice.

accounts.name: dispute_authority
docs: The platform dispute authority, or the order's agreed independent arbitrator.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may crank settlement (pays rent for receipts).

accounts.name: example
docs: Seeded by the content commitment: identical submissions collide and fail.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Platform is paused for new commitments

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.msg: Invalid state transition for this order

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.msg: Deadline must be in the future

errors.name: ConflictOfInterest
errors.msg: Buyer, seller and verifier must be distinct wallets

errors.name: VerifierNotApproved
errors.msg: Verifier is not an approved provider

errors.name: VerifierMismatch
errors.msg: Verifier account does not match the order

errors.name: ListingUnavailable
errors.msg: Listing is not available for purchase

errors.name: RejectionNotAllowed
errors.msg: Verification has not failed; rejection requires a failed verdict

errors.name: ListingModerated
errors.msg: Listing has been moderated and cannot be reactivated

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize the platform

fields.name: subject
docs: Order, verification job, or failure example this attestation is about.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: 0 = no expiry.

fields.name: designated_seller
docs: Default pubkey = open to any seller.

fields.name: arbitrator
docs: Default pubkey = platform dispute authority only.

fields.name: provider
docs: Default pubkey = open to any approved provider with `required_capability`.

fields.name: granted
docs: False when the order settled with a full refund (no entitlement).

fields.name: seller
docs: Default pubkey until a seller accepts a bounty.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Default pubkey when no independent verifier is required.

fields.name: listing
docs: Default pubkey for custom bounties.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Platform fee locked at funding time.

fields.name: designated_seller
docs: If set, only this wallet may accept the bounty (milestone continuations, direct hires).

fields.name: arbitrator
docs: If set, this agreed independent arbitrator may resolve disputes on this order
(in addition to the platform dispute authority).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer target (default = none).

fields.name: capabilities
docs: Capabilities granted by the admin.

fields.name: requested_capabilities
docs: Capabilities the provider asked for.

fields.name: metadata_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain provider profile (hardware, pricing, methods).

fields.name: kind
docs: Service kind (1 = storage, 2 = automated verification, 3 = other).

fields.name: provider
docs: Default = open to any approved provider with the capability.
